decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The use hereby permitted for chauffeuring booking office purposes shall not be carried on outside the following times 7.00am to 7.00pm, Monday to Friday and 10.00am to 3.00pm on Saturday.
Condition : 4 - No  'drop-offs' or 'pick-ups' of customers at the site shall take place.
Condition : 5 - The ground floor shall only be used as a booking office for chauffeuring services and shall not include any facilities for drivers.
description: Change of use from A2 (Employment Agency) to B1 as a chauffeur use
